q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
(a) **Time left until resolution:**
Today is August 18, 2026. NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 earnings release already occurred (the forward guidance was announced on May 20, 2026 for Q2 FY2027). Q2 FY2027 would typically end in July 2026, with earnings released in August 2026. This question is asking for a forecast of something that has likely already been announced or is about to be announced within days. Time to resolution: essentially 0-7 days maximum.

(b) **Most likely outcome and why:**
The research provides explicit, official guidance from NVIDIA announced on May 20, 2026: **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%**. This means NVIDIA's forward guidance range was $89.18 billion to $92.82 billion. This is the actual announced guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue.

The question asks "What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance" — and that guidance has already been publicly stated. The guidance was not a range prediction, but a specific midpoint with a 2% tolerance band.

(c) **What would push the value lower?**
- If actual Q2 FY2027 results came in below the guidance range, NVIDIA might have issued revised guidance downward (but the research shows the guidance was already given)
- Unforeseen adverse business developments between May and the August earnings date
- Significant market disruption or China export restrictions beyond what was already factored in

(d) **What would push the value higher?**
- Better-than-expected Data Center demand
- Upward revision of guidance during the Q2 earnings call itself (though typically guidance is maintained unless conditions warrant change)
- Stronger than anticipated AI/data center market momentum

(e) **Base rate or historical reference values:**
No reliable base rate available in the provided research beyond the explicit guidance figure itself.

---

**Analysis:**

This question has a critical temporal dimension: The forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 was **already announced on May 20, 2026** at **$91.0 billion ± 2%**. We are now on August 18, 2026, which means:

1. The Q2 FY2027 quarter has already ended
2. The forward guidance was provided months ago
3. The actual results and/or updated guidance from the Q2 earnings call are either already released or imminent

The research explicitly states NVIDIA announced an outlook for Q2 FY2027 revenue of **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%** on May 20, 2026.

Given that this guidance has already been officially announced and is public record, the most likely "forward guidance" that will appear in the Q2 FY2027 earnings release is the same figure they already provided: $91.0 billion.

The ±2% band means the reasonable range is $89.18 billion to $92.82 billion, but the official guidance midpoint is $91.0 billion.

My estimate centers on the already-announced guidance of $91.0 billion, with recognition that:
- Companies typically don't revise guidance significantly unless conditions change materially
- The May guidance already excluded China Data Center revenue (a conservative assumption)
- Current consensus estimates cluster around $91 billion

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA has already provided forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue. On May 20, 2026, when reporting its Q1 FY2027 results, NVIDIA announced an outlook for Q2 FY2027 revenue to be **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%** [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This guidance specifically does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

This guidance of $91.0 billion is above the average analyst estimate of $86.84 billion for the quarter [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). Consensus estimates from Hudson Labs and Barchart show revenue expectations for Q2 FY2027 at $91.846 billion and $91 billion respectively [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors), [barchart.com](https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3449043/what-to-expect-from-nvidia-s-q2-2027-earnings-report).
